_note: Conventions of the MKP IFC models and of the model/IFC alignment. Read by nibelungen_virtual_sensors.ifc; change here, not in the code.

structure._note: superstructure (STB) model: elements that define the bridge frame and the girder section

frame._note: mirror_x: model x = mirror_x * t (the model is the mirror image of the real bridge). model_z0_station: station [m] of the model section z = 0, calibrated against the IFC girder depth (RMS 0.11 m); see ifc/frame.py

position_text._note: regular expressions (lower-case text) of the ePset_Position property that describes where in the box girder the sensor sits

sensor_ifc._note: property sets / properties of the sensor proxies
